perf.note: These numbers are input to your review of each person's work, not a verdict. They count the complexity of delivered tickets, not hours or lines.
perf.live: Live: the numbers change as tickets are delivered and scored.
perf.closesOn: Closes on its own on {date}, or later while scores are still coming in (up to the 10th).
perf.changed: Changed since this month was closed. The table shows the numbers as closed; the new ones are in brackets.
perf.reclose: Close again with the new numbers
perf.author: Author
perf.unscored: {n} delivered tickets are not scored yet and are left out.
perf.unmappedHelp: Commits whose git login or email belongs to no member. Map them in Settings → Performance reviews.
perf.empty: No tickets were delivered in this period.
perf.off: Performance reviews are off. The workspace's owner can turn them on in Settings → Performance reviews.
perf.facts: {lines} changed lines in {files} files, {tests} test lines
perf.exportHelp: Everything held about this person, for a request to see their data (GDPR Article 15). You must answer such requests.
perf.regressionsSub: A bug's analysis may suggest which delivered ticket it comes from. It counts against that ticket only once you confirm it, and only within 90 days of its delivery.
perf.settingsSub: Score each delivered ticket's complexity and show the Developers tab under Analytics. Only you, the owner, can see it.
perf.enabledHelp: Automated scoring of employees falls under GDPR Article 22 and, in some countries, needs a works council's agreement. Check before turning it on.
perf.timeZoneHelp: Months and commit days are counted in this zone, for example Asia/Tashkent.
perf.notDone: Jira resolutions that are not done
perf.notDoneHelp: An issue closed with one of these is never counted as delivered.
perf.identitiesSub: Commits are matched to members by their email and username. Add a member's other logins and emails here.
perf.noUnmapped: Every author is matched to a member.
perf.backfillSub: Tickets delivered before scoring was turned on are not scored on their own: each costs a model call. Only commits from the last {days} days are linked, so older tickets show as not delivered.
perf.backfillCredits: Takes about {credits} credits; the workspace has {balance}.
